heroHeadline: Full Maraga Report Reveals Police Jobs Sold for Up to Sh600,000, Taskforce Actually Recommended Keeping Old Uniform
heroSubtitle: The now-public National Taskforce on Police Reforms document shows recruitment corruption complaints from all 47 counties and a recommendation to keep the pre-2018 uniform for three years — undercutting Ruto's August 28 uniform rollout — as Government Spokesperson Charles Owino clarifies the new attire covers only general-duty officers
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
